limitations: The initial public successor baseline imports already-existing instruments; its timestamp does not establish original creation or elapsed labor.
Nonmerge commits are deduplicated by SHA across families; family counts overlap and must not be summed into a unique total.
About is a shared host; its historical changes include unrelated page work. Keep its counts separately selectable.
Legacy HTML hosts contain generated inline shared analysis; the chapter bridge HTML and analysis schema are projections. Separate these from authored-source byte/churn views.
Snapshot bytes and textual line churn are different measures. No runtime performance, quality, hours, human/AI share or productivity is inferred.
No-renames activity counts record moves as delete/add; use the separate rename observations for lineage.
Author/committer dates describe recorded events, not working-session duration. Squash commits compress underlying iterations; deleted branches are absent from current refs.
The future promoted showcase endpoint remains open. Main and dev are exact observed coordinates, not final product milestones.

The selected source corpus omits shared about.css and other global styles, root package/harness changes, cross-repository work, conversation turns and uncommitted experiments. It is a declared navigation corpus, not a complete effort census.
Textual churn is line based and sensitive to formatting and generated duplication; snapshot byte weight is a separate record and is not a download payload.

Full-history SHA counts retain separately recorded squashed promotions and their source-branch ancestors. They count history records, not unique patches or independent implementation acts. Default path-limited git log/rev-list can hide a history arm and give a different total.

methodology.traversal: all ancestors of exact dev SHA; full DAG, nonmerge commit objects, deduplicated by SHA; default path-history simplification is not used
methodology.extraction_command: git log --no-merges --numstat --no-renames --format=<record separator>%H <dev SHA>, then filter declared path families
methodology.line_churn: sum nonmerge numstat additions and deletions in declared paths; path moves count as add/delete; repeat/squashed integration commits retain separate SHA identity
methodology.snapshot_bytes_command: git ls-tree -rl <exact snapshot SHA> filtered by declared path families
methodology.date_field: committer timestamp retained as an event record; author timestamp also provided

traversal_example.meaning: The main-branch workbench-reference promotion is reachable from dev but omitted by default path history simplification. Full-DAG extraction retains this promotion as a distinct history record; it is not an additional independent design iteration.
